 9 die of dengue, 1,982 hospitalised in 24 hours
 Death toll rises to 409 this year 
 Published : 28 October 2026
 • 
 Updated : 28 October 2026, 17:55
 • 
 DISEASE
 SHARE 
 Star Online Report 
 At least nine dengue patients died while 1,982 others were hospitalised in 24 hours till 8:00am today.
 Of the deaths, six were reported in Dhaka division while one each in Chattogram, Khulna and Rajshahi divisions, according to the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS).
 Tap here to add The Daily Star as a trusted source 
 With the new deaths and cases, the total number of deaths this year rose to 409 and cases 130,219.
 Currently, 6,205 dengue patients are undergoing treatment at different hospitals across the country.
